name: Single-Leg Box Jump
instructions: Stand on one leg in front of a box of a height you can land on with control.
Dip slightly on the standing leg, then jump onto the box from that one leg.
Land on both feet on the box, or on the same foot if you can stay stable.
Stand tall on the box, then step down one foot at a time. Do not hop back down.
Finish the set on one leg, then switch legs.
